name: teach-image
description: Make worksheet icons, coloring pages and storybook pictures on your own image server.
long_description:
Lets Claude (chat and Cowork) make and edit pictures with the teacher-image-harness image server running on a Mac on your network: no per-picture cost. Pictures are drawn on that Mac and saved as full-size PNGs on this computer; Claude sees a small preview and the prompt, which become part of your Claude conversation. Reference pictures keep characters the same from page to page.

You need the image server's address and a token for this computer. On the server Mac, run scripts/enable_lan.sh, then scripts/install_image_server.sh (it checks the network address), then scripts/client_tokens.sh add <this-computer's-name>. Here: enter the address and token, check that the extension is switched on, quit and reopen Claude, and allow Claude to use the tools when it asks (until then chats and tasks don't see them). See docs/MCP.md in the repository.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Make new pictures from a description

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change a picture made earlier or a picture file on this computer

tools.name: get_image_job
tools.description: Collect a picture that took longer than one call

tools.name: cancel_image_job
tools.description: Stop a picture that is waiting or being drawn

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Show a picture made earlier, with its prompt and seed

tools.name: save_reference
tools.description: Keep a picture as a reference for consistent characters

tools.name: image_server_status
tools.description: Check the connection, models and queue

server_url.title: Image server address
server_url.description: The Mac running the image server, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:7865 or http://teachers-mac.local:7865 (scripts/enable_lan.sh prints it). On that Mac itself, http://127.0.0.1:7865.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: This computer's token. On the server Mac: scripts/client_tokens.sh add <name>.

output_dir.title: Save pictures in
output_dir.description: Folder for the full-size PNGs. Leave empty for "Generated Images" in your Claude folder (Documents/Claude or ~/Claude, which Cowork can use), or Pictures/Teach Image.
